text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
At the Osaka Hai, Duramente was convinced 
she would grasp something profound from 
today's race.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
To shoulder everything and become the 
world's best, there's something necessary 
that is—

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
The key to it all would likely be Kitasan 
Black. The two faced off in the paddock, 
sparks flying fiercely as neither was 
willing to lose.
